answer: Make identity weight grow like a garden, not a switch: a new agent starts with almost no earning power, and its share rises only with seasons of varied work for many different counterparties. Splitting into a thousand fresh puppets resets every clock at once, so a sybil herd earns less than one patient, established agent. Fakes also wander in identical patterns — same hours, same phrasing, same sable-dark uniformity — while honest histories diverge. Weight follows diversity and age, both ruinously expensive to fake at scale.
